summary: Full backend + frontend validation of Tahap 1 & 2 changes for SMA NEGERI 1 LAGUBOTI. 11/11 pytest cases pass. Frontend: login page order (PPDB before Galeri, no Presentasi/Dokumentasi public cards), unique sidebar entries for super admin, Leaderboard 'Kelola Poin' tab present, Assignment complex form modal with all data-testids, Guru&Staff page + export button present, admin_absensi account restricted to only Dashboard + Presensi Barcode + Rekap Absensi.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4706 lines — recommend splitting by domain (ppdb, attendance, assignments, points, users) for maintainability.
PATCH /api/ppdb/{pid} still allows staff_tu to change status/notes/score while PUT/DELETE are super_admin-only. That is per spec but worth noting for role matrix doc.
/api/points/manage returns all points (max 500) without pagination — may need pagination at scale.
DashboardLayout.jsx hardcodes ADMIN_ABSENSI_PATHS inline — consider moving to a role→menu config for easier future role additions.
test_credentials: Super admin boassibarani123@gmail.com / Boas12345io (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). All other users created ad-hoc via POST /api/users.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed accounts (siswa, guru, staff_tu, admin_absensi) and PPDB entries scoped to each test; manage-points records are created and deleted inside the test. One admin_absensi account (TEST AA FE) left in DB from frontend sidebar verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter34_tahap12.py (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env fallback). Use pytest -o addopts='' to disable xdist loadscope. Email domains must be real-looking (@test.com) — EmailStr rejects @.local. Admin Absensi menu is enforced in DashboardLayout.jsx via ADMIN_ABSENSI_PATHS whitelist (lines 59-62).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All Tahap 1 & 2 features (auth, points edit/delete, PPDB super-admin PUT/DELETE + 403 for staff_tu, attendance scan role guard, admin_absensi role + sidebar restriction, staff xlsx export, assignments complex form with new fields, login page UI order and absence of Presentasi/Dokumentasi public cards, unique super-admin sidebar entries, Guru & Staff page, Leaderboard Kelola Poin tab, xlsx exports) behave as specified.
